profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: Experienced Software Engineer with a demonstrated history of working in the aerospace and consumer electronics industries. Skilled in C, C++, C#, Qt, QML, and Python. Bachelor of Science - BS focused in Electrical Engineering from Union College.

company.name: Top Level Staffing on site at Blue Origin

positions.title: Embedded Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Software Design: Developed software embedded software programs in C for ARM Cortex M4 microcontrollers for use in the electronic controls of commercial laundry equipment. Used IAR Compiler and Eclipse IDE to write software to run on the FreeRTOS real-time operating system. Maintained version control with Git, and collaborated with a team of other software engineers. Participated in code reviews. 
•	Software Debug: Ensured that code written conformed to details in marketing and design specifications. Used J-Link debugger to program and step through code. Worked through a list of bugs maintained in Youtrack, observing task priority. Created new issues for other teams when necessary.

positions.title: Systems Engineer
positions.description:
•	Embedded System Design: Designed circuit boards using PCBArtist schematic and layout software. Developed firmware in C++ to control PIC18 microcontrollers according to customer specifications. Implemented SPI, I2C, and USB protocols, and used shift registers, motor control ICs, power management ICs, MOSFETs, and amplifier circuitry. Used Visual Studio to write C# software to interface between circuit board and simulation software. Created calibration software for making adjustments in the field.
•	Project Management: Selected electromechanical parts according to specifications and physical inspections of aircraft. Worked with mechanical engineering department to ensure proper fit of electromechanical parts. Procured parts and managed production inventory. Managed team of technicians building wire harnesses, circuit boards, and assembling simulators. Maintained Bill of Materials in Microsoft Excel.
•	Testing and Support: Assisted support and installation teams on troubleshooting issues at customer sites. Traveled to customer locations when needed for more complicated problems. Worked with vendors and redesigned components to reduce production costs.  Created test software for in-house development. Tested and debugged finished products, and taught technicians the test procedures.

positions.title: Production Engineer
positions.description:
• PCB Design: Designed circuits and selected components according to customer specifications. Built schematic symbols and created schematics using Altium. Prepared component footprints and fabrication drawings. Placed components and routed PCB’s according to design requirements. Prepared and generated necessary documents for PCB manufacturing, including bill of materials. Determined second sources and part replacements as needed.

• Firmware Testing: Used IAR Embedded Workbench to load firmware onto ARM processors. Developed and executed test procedures in “C” programming language for the individual functions of the project. Verified output with an oscilloscope. Instructed test technicians on the test procedures.

• Electronic Manufacturing: Built customized electronic products for consumers and businesses according to engineering documentation. Assembled PCB’s using the Pick & Place machine and reflow oven. Soldered fine-pitch SMT components and through-hole parts. Performed PCB rework using a hot air tool and solder-sucker. Built cables and harnesses, modified enclosures, and constructed final product. Managed technicians and performed quality assurance checks.

positions.title: Graduate Research Assistant
positions.description:
• AUV control system: Wrote a system in MATLAB to simulate communication between modules of an autonomous underwater vehicle (AUV). Developed high-level code to interface the sonars, depth sensor, GPS, and vehicle controller with the master controller. 

• Swimmer characterization: Characterized the motion of a swimmer using sonar data taken with a Doppler signal. Filtered the data in various ways to differentiate the swimmer from other objects in the water.

• SPARK UUV simulator: Designed a simulator for unmanned underwater vehicles (UUVs) using the Python-based SPARK artificial intelligence framework, giving the vehicle the ability to create its own path for following waypoints and avoiding obstacles. Developed the simulation environment using Python.

• MATLAB UUV simulator: Improved existing parameters, such as: moments of inertia, centers of gravity, and buoyancy, in order for simulation results to match with test data.

company.name: Applied Research Laboratories, The University of Texas at Austin
